title: Healthy Relationships for Teens
subtitle: Age-appropriate education, prevention, risk reduction, and support related to healthy relationships for teens.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports education on communication, consent, and boundaries as effective for promoting healthy relationships and reducing teen dating violence. Emerging research addresses the evolving impacts of social media. Limitations include cultural variability and gaps in longitudinal data.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
